summary: Second G6 correction after independent re-review rejected five escaping detail endpoints. The source retains simple primary-path components, centered projected footprint margins, Manifest v3's supported ramp/terminal/stair topology, thirteen Java tier-0 colonnade posts, and a touching Informatica exit corridor/dock. Informatica and Atlassian detail strokes are now on existing tier-0 faces; a broader author audit also found and corrected two MacStadium roof-seam endpoints missed by the prior review. Literal master hashes were recomputed for all three affected assets. This author report is not independent acceptance evidence and does not claim I0 integration, placement readiness, promotion, or an external handoff envelope.
